name: North Carolina Department of Public Safety
source_citation: North Carolina Department of Public Safety Strategic Plan (revised July 15, 2026)
mission: Safeguarding and preserving the lives and property of North Carolinians through state-of-the-art disaster prevention, emergency management, law enforcement, and juvenile justice.

goals.title: Make DPS a career destination
goals.citation: North Carolina Department of Public Safety Strategic Plan (revised July 15, 2026), p. 6
objectives: 1.1 Enhance the recruitment and retention of a highly qualified workforce
1.2 Ensure the Department has a well-trained and professional workforce

goals.title: Excellent service, safety, and innovation
goals.citation: North Carolina Department of Public Safety Strategic Plan (revised July 15, 2026), p. 9
goals.description: Foster a culture of excellent service, safety, and innovation.
objectives: 2.1 Provide each Division with safe, appropriate facilities and infrastructure
2.3 Use data to inform operational decision making

goals.title: Comprehensive approach to public safety
goals.citation: North Carolina Department of Public Safety Strategic Plan (revised July 15, 2026), p. 12
goals.description: Strengthen our comprehensive approach to public safety.
objectives: 3.2 Enhance community safety through prevention and intervention
3.3 Strengthen emergency preparedness and response through continuity of operations
3.4 Augment community-based programs that reduce juvenile crime through early prevention, enhanced re-entry services, and increased service capacity
